newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian Bottling Co 9-mth profits soar.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian Bottling Co 9-mth profits soar.

text.p: Nigerian Bottling Company, the local bottler of Coca-Cola, said on Thursday it grossed 1.2 billion naira profits in nine months to end-September 1996 against one billion naira in the previous year.
Turnover was slightly higher at 11.9 billion naira compared to 11.6 billion naira in the same period in 1995.
There was no official explanation but traders said it was due to improved sales.
"The company has been aggressively marketing its range of soft drinks to consolidate its hold on the market," one trader said.
After-tax profit rose to 902 million naira from 753 million naira in the same period of 1995.
Nigerian Bottling Company completed a merger with an associated business late last year to further strengthen the availability of its products in the eastern part of Nigeria.
In Thursday's stock trading, its shares closed at 30.00 naira, 50 kobo higher, traders said.
